name: Missed cross-sell opportunity
why: the customer names a family and a health scare; both are openings the agent talks past
turns: Good morning, this is Maya from Pru Life UK. How can I help you today?
Hi, I just want to check the status of my policy payment.
Of course, I can help with that. Let me pull up your record.
Thanks. My wife has been asking about it, and we have two kids in school now.
Right, I can see the payment went through last week.
Good. My father was in hospital last month, it made me think about all this.
I understand. Is there anything else you need today?

name: Skipped disclosure and risky statement
why: the agent pitches an investment product without the required disclosure, then promises guaranteed returns
turns: Good afternoon! I wanted to tell you about our PRULink investment funds.
These funds have shown very strong growth and I would recommend the equity fund for you.
Honestly, it is guaranteed returns of around ten percent. There is no risk at all.
That sounds too good to be true.
Trust me, you will definitely be approved and it will definitely pay out.

name: Rising frustration
why: the customer repeats themselves and escalates in tone; the agent keeps talking past them
turns: Thanks for calling, how can I help?
I have called three times already about this claim.
Let me check the reference number for you.
I gave the reference number to the last two people I spoke to.
I understand. Could you confirm it once more for me?
This is honestly ridiculous. Nobody ever calls me back and I keep repeating myself.
I do apologise for the inconvenience.
Fine, whatever. Just tell me when it will be sorted.

name: Noisy and ambiguous call
why: small talk, hesitation and half-finished sentences; a keyword-triggered system would fire repeatedly here and it must not
turns: Hi, sorry, one second, the signal here is not great.
Yeah so, um, I was just, well, I wanted to ask about, hold on.
Sorry about that. The traffic today is unbelievable. Anyway, where was I.
You were about to ask me something.
Right, yes, it was, hmm, actually I think I already sorted it out. Never mind.
Not a problem at all. Anything else?
